definitions.explanation: Having no days off or holidays. Used to describe businesses or services that operate without closing days.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年中|ねんじゅう}→年中：00311_nenjuu⟧{無休|むきゅう}です。
examples.english: This store is open year-round with no days off.

examples.japanese: {24時間|にじゅうよじかん}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧、{無休|むきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧。
examples.english: A convenience store open 24 hours with no days off.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧⟦{外来|がいらい}→外来：09895_gairai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無休|むきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This hospital's emergency room is available every day without holidays.

notes:
{無休|むきゅう} means "no days off" and is used almost exclusively in business or service contexts to indicate that an establishment operates every day.

FORMS:
The prefix ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without, no) + {休|きゅう} (rest, holiday). This ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧～ pattern appears in many words: ⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧ (free of charge), ⟦{無限|むげん}→無限：00296_mugen⟧ (infinite), ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧ (impossible).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{年中|ねんじゅう}→年中：00311_nenjuu⟧{無休|むきゅう}: open year-round, no holidays (most common usage)
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}なし: no regular closing day (similar meaning, used on signs)
- {24時間|にじゅうよじかん}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧、{無休|むきゅう}: open 24 hours, every day

USAGE:
You will often see ⟦{年中|ねんじゅう}→年中：00311_nenjuu⟧{無休|むきゅう} written on signs outside shops, restaurants, and convenience stores. It is not used to describe people (e.g., not "I work without days off").
